world:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a highly coherent professional art direction approval sheet for an ORIGINAL voxel sandbox titled "SEEDLANDS / PIXEL WORLD". Landscape composition, three panels: top 55% is first-person gameplay-like view of a modest meadow with cubic dirt-and-grass terrain, cubic oak trees, simple wooden small shelter with visible plank structure, pig and cow and small human settler, small red/yellow flowers and sparse short grass. Bottom left 30% shows a clean 5x3 sheet of large legible deliberately authored PIXEL ART texture tiles: grass top, dirt, stone, cobblestone, oak bark, log end rings, wooden planks, red brick courses, bookshelf with clear book spines, furnace face with dark opening, pumpkin face, wool fiber clusters, sand, ore with grouped mineral inclusions, luminous mineral. Bottom right 15% shows identical small dark stone-room lighting study with torch, glowing mineral, lit furnace, and pumpkin lamp casting warm local light on nearby surfaces.
Visual target: the legibility and disciplined pixel craft of vanilla Minecraft, but all artwork original. STRICT low-resolution 16x16-style pixel clusters on large simple flat cuboids; no tiny modeled voxel bumps on texture faces. Geometry simple squared forms with rectangular limbs, flat pixel eyes, pig pink snout and ears; restrained original proportions. Pixel art texture design uses larger intentional clusters, 3-5 value steps per material, clear structure, no random salt-and-pepper noise. Environment is flat-textured realtime WebGL-like, no cinematic depth of field, no bloom, no path-traced hyperrealism, no smooth sculpted/chibi miniature figures. Short grass and flowers are two intersecting thin flat alpha-cutout sprite planes with transparent background around stems and petals, NOT modeled blades, NOT cubes, no rocks scattered on every grass tile. Natural moderately saturated green, warm earthy wood and dirt, neutral gray stone. Avoid ornate brass medieval UI and decorative frames. Straight clean grid, off-white annotation background. Sparse text only 'WORLD', 'MATERIALS', 'LIGHT'. This is a concept board, not actual playable output. Make texture studies large and readable and consistent with the world panel.
creatures:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: SEEDLANDS game art approval sheet, landscape 3:2, two clean clearly separated sections on neutral warm gray background. Title 'SEEDLANDS / CREATURES + ITEMS'. Art style: original game assets following disciplined vanilla Minecraft-like PIXEL ART principles, simple flat cuboid low-poly forms, sharp intentional low-resolution pixel clusters, 3-5 shades per material, no smooth clay, no miniature sculptures, no gradients or blurry painterly textures. Top 60%: evenly spaced 3D orthographic lineup of exactly 15 creature/NPC designs across three rows, each separately readable and labeled. Row 1 'PIG' salmon-pink pig with snout and four legs; 'COW' brown-white cow with horns; 'SHEEP' cream wool sheep; 'CHICKEN' white chicken red comb; 'SQUID' blue-gray squid with distinct arms. Row 2 'WOLF' gray wolf; 'PIG ZOMBIE' rugged undead pig humanoid; 'ZOMBIE' undead green-gray humanoid in torn earth-color clothes; 'SKELETON' pale bone archer with open rib space; 'SPIDER' dark low spider with eight legs. Row 3 'CREEPER' original mossy angular four-legged explosive creature with original facial markings; 'SLIME' translucent green cube with eyes; 'SETTLER' simple human teal-clad explorer; 'GRAZER' tan cream-faced deerlike creature; 'NIGHT STALKER' charcoal angular predator with restrained teal accents and amber eyes. Respect stable blocky pixel proportions with readable heads, limb gaps and faces; enough highlights to see dark creatures.
Bottom 40%: two rows of pixel inventory icon designs, each centered in a subtle square tile: brick as single terracotta brick; clay lump; book with spine and page edges; sugar pile; sliced-frosted cake; round chocolate-chip cookie; cocoa beans; black music disc with yellow center; dry branching bush with transparent silhouette; red flower with thin stem and petals; red capped white-spotted mushroom; ladder with open rungs; torch with wood shaft and bright flame; fence as actual posts and rails; half-height stone slab; wood stairs; four visibly distinct wool cubes white orange magenta light-blue. Icon area is hand-crafted-looking pixel art, visibly crisp 16x16 or 32x32-like pixel grid, not generic circles, not noisy square texture swatches. No opaque backgrounds inside flower/mushroom/ladder icons. Precise polished alignment, no decorative medieval brass frame. All assets original, no reused game textures. Only labels listed and section labels 'CREATURES' and 'ITEMS'.
